analysis.aggregation: frozen V2 _macro: seeds per scene/role/query, then queries, roles, scenes
analysis.integrity: RAW recomputation must reproduce every sealed depth_absrel within 1e-5 and depth_delta1 within 1/valid_count, else abort

labels.ABOVE: frozen V2 evidence rule: mean>0, CIlo>0, >=75% scenes not worse
labels.BELOW: mirror rule: mean<0, CIhi<0, >=75% scenes not better

analysis.metrics: measurement_metrics depth_absrel and depth_delta1 on GT-valid pixels

readouts.MEDIAN_SCALED: RAW * median(GT) / median(RAW) per query view on GT-valid pixels; uses GT scale, a shape-only diagnostic
readouts.RAW: sealed renderer depth sum_i w_i t_i (the frozen metric input)

references.REF_TRAIN_ABSREL_OPTIMAL: 1/t-weighted median of pooled TRAIN primary-query GT: the AbsRel-optimal constant
references.REF_TRAIN_MEDIAN: median of pooled TRAIN primary-query GT
references.under_MEDIAN_SCALED: both become the per-view GT-median constant

summary_status.NO_CARRIER_ABOVE_GEOMETRY_FREE_REFERENCE: no V2-V4 carrier variant ABOVE its primary reference on RAW or OPACITY_NORMALIZED AbsRel/delta1

kind: post-hoc secondary re-analysis of sealed predictions; no training
